name: Burundi

nso.name: Institut de Statistiques et d'Etudes Economiques du Burundi (ISTEEBU), restructured c. 2023 as the Institut National de la Statistique du Burundi (INSBU)

latest_census.notes: Recensement General de la Population et de l'Habitation (RGPH) of 16-17 August 2008 is the last census with published results (the previous one was 1990). Religion: the 2008 questionnaire had a religion item and the results were published (order of magnitude: Catholic ~62%, Protestant ~22%, Muslim ~2.5%). Ethnicity: not asked -- Burundi, like Rwanda, does not enumerate Hutu/Tutsi/Twa; the post-Arusha political settlement treats the ethnic count as too sensitive, so the census questionnaire omits it. Language: I cannot recall a language item on the 2008 questionnaire; leave null. A new census (RGPHAE, combining population, housing, agriculture and livestock) was in preparation from 2022 with enumeration planned around 2024; I cannot confirm whether it was carried out or what it asked. Note also that Burundi legislated in 2023 a reorganisation from 18 provinces / 119 communes to 5 provinces / 42 communes, to take effect after the 2025 elections; any new census will be published on the new layout, which matches neither level of the packet's boundary file.

subnational_sources.title: RGPH 2008 -- Resultats definitifs, thematic volumes (socio-cultural characteristics), tables by province
subnational_sources.matches_boundary_level: admin1 (17 of 18: Rumonge, created in 2015 from parts of Bururi and Bujumbura Rural, has no 2008 row)
subnational_sources.evidence: Recalled: the definitive 2008 results were issued as a set of thematic tomes in PDF (spatial distribution, socio-cultural characteristics, education, activity, etc.), tabulated by the 17 provinces of the time. Whether the religion table also goes to commune level (which would join the 119 admin2 shapes) I cannot say from memory.

subnational_sources.title: Troisieme Enquete Demographique et de Sante au Burundi (EDSB-III) 2016-17, religion by province
subnational_sources.publisher: ISTEEBU / Ministere de la Sante / ICF (DHS Program)
subnational_sources.evidence: Recalled: the Burundi DHS reports religion among background characteristics and its sampling domains are the 18 provinces. A sampled estimate, ranked below the 2008 count.

subnational_sources.title: IPUMS-International: Burundi 1990 and 2008 census samples
subnational_sources.evidence: Recalled with low confidence that Burundi 2008 is in the IPUMS catalogue with a religion variable and province identifiers; verify before relying on it.

tier_reason: A census religion count exists (RGPH 2008) but is 18 years old, PDF-only on recollection, and tabulated for 17 provinces against a boundary file of 18; ethnicity is not asked (Tier C field) and language is unknown.
recommended_action: Crawl isteebu.bi (and, if it has moved, the INSBU successor site) for the RGPH 2008 definitive-results tomes; extract religion by province and, if present, by commune. Join 17 provinces to admin1 by name and leave Rumonge visibly empty rather than splitting Bururi. Declare ethnicity not_collected with the post-conflict policy reason. Check whether the 2024 RGPHAE has published anything; if it has, expect the new 5-province layout and record the mismatch.

summary: Burundi's last published census is the RGPH of August 2008 (ISTEEBU, now INSBU; isteebu.bi). It asked religion and published it by the 17 provinces of the time, one short of the boundary file's 18 because Rumonge was created in 2015; the results are PDF tomes as far as I recall, so Tier B. Ethnicity is not enumerated, a deliberate post-conflict choice, and should be declared not_collected; whether language was asked I cannot say. A new census was planned for 2024 and the country is moving to a 5-province layout, so a runner should check for new publications but expect a geography that matches neither level.
